title: Intermittent crash on ARM64 after one IPC message
goal: Find the root cause of the client exiting after the first IPC message on ARM64 builds, with a reproducer.
question: Why does the client exit after one message on ARM64 but not x86_64?

in: CI logs for the arm64 job
scope.notes: Read-only on the repo; experiments go in task directories or /tmp on the ARM box.

resources.name: repo
resources.notes: Read-only. Do not modify tracked files.

resources.name: armbox
resources.notes: Shared ARM64 dev box. Work under /tmp/inv-arm-crash/<task-id>.

resources.name: armbox_port_9000
resources.notes: Only one test server at a time.

safety: Never modify tracked files in the repo.
Never run sudo or destructive commands on armbox.
Kill every process you start; record it with `task started` first.

success: Root cause identified and located to specific code (file:line).
A minimal reproducer that fails on ARM64 and passes on x86_64.
At least two independent lines of evidence (e.g. static + experiment).
criteria.evidence_standard: Claims about runtime behaviour need an experiment or log excerpt; static-only claims must say so and carry at most 'med' confidence.
stop_if: The crash cannot be reproduced after two dedicated attempts — report and ask the human.

lanes.name: static
lanes.mandate: Read and trace the IPC and client source; form and test hypotheses statically.

lanes.name: logs
lanes.mandate: Mine CI logs and crash output for the arm64 job; correlate failures with commits and conditions.

lanes.name: experiments
lanes.mandate: Build and run small programs and tests on armbox to confirm or refute hypotheses.
lanes.evidence_standard: Record exact commands, exit codes and output excerpts.

lanes.name: skunkworks
lanes.mandate: Generalist: unroutable requests, cross-lane asks, salvage of failed work, odd jobs no other lane owns.
